note.zh: 基础权重95:5。灵督终末者起源只会得到轮回之终末；已有人掷出、全局禁用或另有终末者帝国时为0；他国达天灾5级×2，曾与骑士相遇×5。
note.en: Base weights 95:5. Endbringers origin always gets the End of the Cycle; it is 0 if already rolled, disabled, or another empire is an Endbringer; ×2 if another empire reached crisis level 5, ×5 after meeting the Knights.

notes.zh: 选项后开启“虚空低语者”首次接触特殊项目（常规/蜂巢/机械三种版本），其完成事件 shroud.4045 属于该项目的故事（C3）。编译器未识别 enable_patron_first_contact_project，故此处无连线。
notes.en: Starts the Whisperers in the Void first-contact special project (regular/hive/machine variants); its completion event shroud.4045 belongs to that project story (C3). The compiler does not read enable_patron_first_contact_project, so no edge is drawn here.

notes.zh: 由光环拥有者（立约方）看到；一天后其他人类玩家收到 shroud.4971，所有星系被摧毁。
notes.en: Seen by the aura owner (covenant empire); one day later other human players get shroud.4971 and every system is destroyed.

scope.zh: 上超主掷骰、两种结果、轮回之终末立约及其后果（光环扩散通知、胜利、决议宣战、清算与研究项目、潜入死寂、创造协约）均已核对。虚空低语者首次接触项目之后的内容属于C3项目故事；局势完成后的 utopia.3320 属于 the-shroud。
scope.en: Great-patron roll, both outcomes, the End of the Cycle covenant and its consequences (aura notices, victory, Community war, Reckoning project, silent delve, Creation accord) were checked. Content after the Whisperers first-contact project belongs to the C3 project story; utopia.3320 after the situation completes belongs to the-shroud.

uncertain: The chance per month (calc_greater_patron_roll_chance = 1 + 3 × mid-game years passed, max 100) is read from the script value; how the engine evaluates mid_game_years_passed before mid-game was not tested.
